explication: Bubble Tea is a Go framework for building stateful terminal applications. The principal workflow is: a user produces terminal input, Bubble Tea decodes it into messages, invokes the application model’s Update method, executes returned commands, obtains a View, and renders that view back to the terminal. The graph also preserves documented keyboard/mouse handling, cell rendering, color profiles, clipboard support, and external command execution. Some dispatch details are inferred from documented interfaces because tea.go was only partially sampled.
